jtwc.text:
WTPN32 PGTW 061500
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/TROPICAL DEPRESSION 13W (KUJIRA) WARNING NR 008//
RMKS/
1. TROPICAL DEPRESSION 13W (KUJIRA) WARNING NR 008    
   02 ACTIVE TROPICAL CYCLONES IN NORTHWESTPAC
   MAX SUSTAINED WINDS BASED ON ONE-MINUTE AVERAGE
   WIND RADII VALID OVER OPEN WATER ONLY
    ---
   WARNING POSITION:
   061200Z --- NEAR 16.7N 122.9E
     MOVEMENT PAST SIX HOURS - 105 DEGREES AT 12 KTS
     POSITION ACCURATE TO WITHIN 060 NM
     POSITION BASED ON CENTER LOCATED BY SATELLITE
   PRESENT WIND DISTRIBUTION:
   MAX SUSTAINED WINDS - 025 KT, GUSTS 035 KT
   WIND RADII VALID OVER OPEN WATER ONLY
   DISSIPATING AS A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE OVER WATER
   REPEAT POSIT: 16.7N 122.9E
    ---
   FORECASTS:
   12 HRS, VALID AT:
   070000Z --- 17.1N 125.3E
   MAX SUSTAINED WINDS - 025 KT, GUSTS 035 KT
   WIND RADII VALID OVER OPEN WATER ONLY
   DISSIPATED AS A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE OVER WATER
   VECTOR TO 24 HR POSIT: 075 DEG/ 12 KTS
    ---
   24 HRS, VALID AT:
   071200Z --- 17.8N 127.7E
   MAX SUSTAINED WINDS - 025 KT, GUSTS 035 KT
   WIND RADII VALID OVER OPEN WATER ONLY
   DISSIPATED AS A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE OVER WATER
    ---
REMARKS:
061500Z POSITION NEAR 16.8N 123.5E.
06AUG26. TROPICAL DEPRESSION 13W (KUJIRA), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY
167 NM NORTHEAST OF MANILA, PHILIPPINES, HAS TRACKED EAST-
SOUTHEASTWARD AT 12 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. ANIMATED ENHANCED
INFRARED IMAGERY DEPICTS STRONG WESTERLY AND NORTHWESTERLY GRADIENT
FLOW SURGING ACROSS LUZON AND CONVERGING IN THE PHILIPPINE SEA,
ENHANCED BY INFLOW INTO TYPHOON 12W (DOLPHIN) . THE LOW-LEVEL
CIRCULATION DID NOT SURVIVE THE JOURNEY ACROSS LUZON AND THE
MID-LEVEL CIRCULATION HAS WASHED OUT INTO THE CONVERGING WINDS AND
CONVECTION ON THE EASTERN COAST OF LUZON. THE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS
HIGHLY UNFAVORABLE FOR DEVELOPMENT, CHARACTERIZED BY HIGH (30-35 KTS)
VERTICAL WIND SHEAR, SLIGHT MID-LEVEL DRY AIR ENTRAINMENT, AND THE
STRONG GRADIENT FLOW. THOUGHT THE LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION  IS LIKELY
COMPLETELY GONE, WHATEVER REMNANTS ARE LEFT ARE EXPECTED TO TRACK
NORTHEASTWARD WHILE BECOMING ABSORBED BY THE WESTERLIES AND INFLOW
INTO TYPHOON 12W (DOLPHIN). THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS SYSTEM
BY THE JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL BE
CLOSELY MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF REGENERATION. MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE
AT 061200Z IS 1000 MB. MAXIMUM SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 061200Z IS
12 FEET. REFER TO TYPHOON 12W (DOLPHIN) WARNINGS (WTPN31 PGTW)
FOR SIX-HOURLY UPDATES.//
NNNN
